description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Magento/Adobe Commerce Products via the REST API. Search-then-write per row (Magento's PUT /V1/products/:sku is update-ONLY, not a true upsert) -- GET /V1/products/:sku → PUT the match or POST a new product (requires sku/name/price/attribute_set_id at minimum).

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row → one Magento product (upserted by matching on sku).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored). No downstream data — write side effect lands in Magento/Adobe Commerce.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column → Magento field name. MUST include a mapping to `sku`.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

name: Magento Product Upsert
